risks: The seven cases were selected using earlier outcomes and the five heads share one selected seed. No independent confirmation, accuracy, CE, Macro-F1, population equivalence or quantum/phase necessity follows. No source producer or raw trace was independently audited here.

SVD optimality concerns Frobenius error in this anchor-dependent log-ratio representation. It does not optimize attention distance, score preservation or argmax. Projection damage does not exclude another decision-preserving rank-eight representation; a small change supplies no population null result.

full_row_rank=keep.all() is a full-row-rank test only for a design with rows no greater than columns. This packet fixes D to 253x1028; the worker reports its actual shape but does not explicitly assert that total row count. Do not reuse that predicate or the compilation claim for a tall design. Numerical rank at rcond=1e-6 is not exact rank.

The compilation flag allows log-ratio residual below 1e-4 and does not separately certify compiled-score argmax preservation. Its parameters are real-arithmetic finite-case coefficients, with no fp32 instantiated-head, bounded-norm, optimization or generalization guarantee. Stored query equality across cases relies on the fixed-head provenance; calibration alone does not prove shared query identity.

Compressed inventory size is not a decompressed-memory bound. The pinned trusted input and stated small shapes underpin resource adequacy. NPZ bytes are hashed and subsequently reopened for decoding, so the fixed-input premise also requires source files to remain unchanged between those reads.

The deployed dispatch-time memory probe covers cgroup v2, while v1 is checked in fresh preflight. The controller leader lock does not itself exclude concurrent external submissions or unrelated configuration writers. Concurrent activity should preserve the existing stop/unknown-state handling.
